Range: native-agent-stack-token-practice-review commit 231077d095511391e7dd8a5ab25c451331332c5e (parent) to bdd04ca50eb781f8366c955f481479b7a7f57cbd (this worktree's HEAD, 'Re-record the 12 trading layer verdicts from layer-specific packets (#74)'), 20 files changed spanning .json, .md, .py and .html. old/<path> and new/<path> were extracted with `git show <rev>:<path>` and verified byte-identical to `git show` output before running difft (spot-checked on docs/grand-catalog-handbook.md).
preregistered: If difft --display=inline exits 0 and produces non-empty, non-fallback output (no 'failed to parse' / 'could not find a parser' / panic message) for all 20 changed-file pairs, that settles the gap's specific complaint (single-fixture-pair acceptance) by demonstrating difft parses and reports every changed file in a real, larger, heterogeneous (json/md/py/html) changed set, not just the synthetic before.py/after.py pair -- while still not being a matched comparison against a challenger structural-diff tool (no second tool is installed; that remains open per gap 7). If any file fails to parse, produces empty output despite a real byte-level diff, or crashes difft, that file is recorded as a failure and the gap stays open for that file type.
